info.title: Screenshots
info.description: Renders a webpage exactly as a real browser would, including all its scripts and dynamic content, then takes a picture of it. You can capture just the visible area or the whole scrollable page, choose the screen size, wait for slow-loading images to finish, and hide cookie banners or popups before the picture is taken.
info.x-guidance: Send the target url plus any optional capture settings. Set load_lazy true and wait_until to networkidle0 or networkidle2 for pages that load content as you scroll, such as image galleries or social feeds. Set allow_popups false (default) to automatically hide cookie banners and chat widgets. The response gives a short-lived link to the captured image, not the image itself, so download it promptly if you need to keep it.

url.title: Url
url.description: The web address of the page you want a picture of.

full_page.title: Full Page
full_page.description: If true, captures the entire scrollable page instead of just what is visible on screen.

viewport.description: The width and height of the browser window used to show the page, in pixels.

wait_until.title: Wait Until
wait_until.description: When to consider the page ready to capture.

allow_popups.title: Allow Popups
allow_popups.description: If false, cookie banners, consent popups, and chat widgets are hidden before the picture is taken.

load_lazy.title: Load Lazy
load_lazy.description: If true, scrolls through the page first so slow-loading images finish loading before the picture is taken.
